Scale: the plate appears to be about 26 cm across. Each toast slice is about 10-11 cm square and about 1.2 cm thick, which is roughly 30 g for a slice of toast. The jam slice is the same size plus the jam. The two egg bites (likely baked egg or sweet potato cakes) are each about 6 cm across and 3 cm tall, roughly 45 g each. The orange-yellow color and soufflé-like texture suggest baked egg bites at about 150 kcal/100 g.
